title: Flag shard weight drift against CI durations
body:
Outcome: a test file whose CI duration drifts above its shard weight is flagged before it skews the plan.
Evidence: #349/#350 split files with local-estimate weights (~0.5x CI); shard 6/8 then held ~80 CI-seconds and ran 22-26 s on main (runs 42427889516, 42428030805) while predicted at 16 s, until #354 refreshed weights from CI.
Acceptance: node scripts/shard-wall-report.mjs (or the refresh script) prints files whose median CI durationMs exceeds their weight by more than 30% over the fetched runs, with a test on a fixture run; the lead runs it after any split.
